answer: A concrete Sybil defense is bond staking: each voting agent must lock collateral in escrow before its ballot counts. A swarm of bots can mint a thousand identities, but every one now needs real funds frozen, so the attacker pays linearly per fake seat and forfeits all of it when its votes are caught. The velvet quality here is patience, since payouts vest slowly, so a fake haven of parked accounts cannot instantly flood one round with weight. Honest agents stake once, while the falcon watches for wallets funded from a single source and flags that cluster before it counts.
